Here’s a simpler breakdown of the text:

The *Guardian* is launching a temporary newsletter called *Fighting Back*. Until the next U.S. president takes office, it will share ideas from experts on how to defend civil rights and freedoms under a Trump presidency.

If you’re not already subscribed, you can sign up to receive it.

The article then gives advice: Take time to relax—breathe, walk, or meditate. Talk to people you trust. When you’re ready, write down your personal goals for making a difference. Pick an issue you care about (like voting rights, climate change, or justice).

Next, think about how different levels of power—local government, state leaders, federal laws, big companies, or community groups—affect that issue. Map out how they connect to your cause so you can plan how to take action.

In short: Stay calm, focus on what matters to you, and figure out how to push for change.
